plan.title: Optional technical-stage terms do not block vendor submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required.
Provide the required project title.
Create the Technical + RFQ stage pair.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add one item for the event.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured event.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the invited vendor answer the Technical stage and submit a 100 quote on the RFQ without requiring a second vendor login.
Confirm the vendor submission was accepted.
Inspect the submitted event in the vendor portal.
Open the vendor's Technical stage view.
Confirm the first optional clause is visible on the Technical stage.
Confirm the second optional clause is visible on the Technical stage.
Check the vendor view reports the optional clauses as not accepted.
Open the vendor's RFQ pricing view.
Confirm the Technical-only clause is not presented on the RFQ stage.
Confirm the second Technical-only clause is not presented on the RFQ stage.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's Technical response.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's RFQ bid.
